const BUILDING_CIV_LEVEL = {
  clinic:2,
  securityCenter:2,
  entertainment:3,
  scienceCenter:3,
  missileBattery:3,
  laserBattery:4
};

const SHIP_CIV_LEVEL = {
  scout:1,
  interceptor:1,
  cargo:1,
  corvette:2,
  colonizer:2,
  researchMiner:2,
  repair:2,
  frigate:3,
  destroyer:3,
  cruiser:4,
  guardian:4,
  battleship:5,
  dreadnought:6,
  titan:6
};

function getCivilizationLevel(planet){
  if(!planet || planet.owner !== 'player') return 0;
  if(!planet.civilizationLevel) planet.civilizationLevel = 1;
  return Math.max(1,Math.min(CIVILIZATION_LEVELS.length,planet.civilizationLevel));
}

function civilizationInfo(planetOrLevel){
  const level = typeof planetOrLevel === 'number'
    ? planetOrLevel
    : getCivilizationLevel(planetOrLevel);
  return CIVILIZATION_LEVELS[Math.max(0,Math.min(CIVILIZATION_LEVELS.length-1,level-1))];
}

function requiredCivilizationLevelForBuilding(type){
  return BUILDING_CIV_LEVEL[type] || 1;
}

function requiredCivilizationLevelForShip(type){
  return SHIP_CIV_LEVEL[type] || 1;
}

function civilizationProductionMultiplier(planet){
  const info = civilizationInfo(planet);
  return 1 + (info?.productionBonus || 0);
}

function civilizationScienceBonus(planet){
  const info = civilizationInfo(planet);
  return info?.scienceBonus || 0;
}

function builtMiningStationCount(planet){
  return mineTypesForPlanet(planet)
    .filter(([,type]) => (planet.buildings?.[type] || 0) > 0)
    .length;
}

function totalMiningStationLevels(planet){
  return mineTypesForPlanet(planet).reduce((sum,[,type]) => {
    return sum + miningStationLevel(planet,type);
  },0);
}

function activePlanetDefenseCount(planet){
  return (planet.buildings?.missileBattery || 0) +
         (planet.buildings?.laserBattery || 0);
}

function civilizationRequirements(planet,targetLevel){
  const depositCount = Math.max(1,mineTypesForPlanet(planet).length);
  const minesBuilt = builtMiningStationCount(planet);
  const miningLevels = totalMiningStationLevels(planet);
  const satisfaction = calculateSatisfaction(planet);
  const science = scienceCenterLevel(planet);
  const defense = activePlanetDefenseCount(planet);

  if(targetLevel === 2){
    const needMines = Math.min(2,depositCount);
    return [
      {label:'Население',current:Math.floor(planet.population || 0),target:800,unit:'',met:(planet.population||0)>=800},
      {label:'Добывающие станции',current:minesBuilt,target:needMines,unit:'',met:minesBuilt>=needMines},
      {label:'Удовлетворённость',current:satisfaction,target:55,unit:'%',met:satisfaction>=55}
    ];
  }

  if(targetLevel === 3){
    return [
      {label:'Население',current:Math.floor(planet.population || 0),target:1800,unit:'',met:(planet.population||0)>=1800},
      {label:'Освоить все месторождения',current:minesBuilt,target:depositCount,unit:'',met:minesBuilt>=depositCount},
      {label:'Удовлетворённость',current:satisfaction,target:65,unit:'%',met:satisfaction>=65}
    ];
  }

  if(targetLevel === 4){
    return [
      {label:'Население',current:Math.floor(planet.population || 0),target:3500,unit:'',met:(planet.population||0)>=3500},
      {label:'Научный центр',current:science,target:1,unit:' ур.',met:science>=1},
      {label:'Суммарные уровни добычи',current:miningLevels,target:depositCount*2,unit:'',met:miningLevels>=depositCount*2},
      {label:'Удовлетворённость',current:satisfaction,target:70,unit:'%',met:satisfaction>=70}
    ];
  }

  if(targetLevel === 5){
    const miningTarget = Math.max(8,depositCount*3);
    return [
      {label:'Население',current:Math.floor(planet.population || 0),target:7000,unit:'',met:(planet.population||0)>=7000},
      {label:'Научный центр',current:science,target:2,unit:' ур.',met:science>=2},
      {label:'Суммарные уровни добычи',current:miningLevels,target:miningTarget,unit:'',met:miningLevels>=miningTarget},
      {label:'Оборонные установки',current:defense,target:2,unit:'',met:defense>=2},
      {label:'Удовлетворённость',current:satisfaction,target:75,unit:'%',met:satisfaction>=75}
    ];
  }

  if(targetLevel === 6){
    const miningTarget = Math.max(12,depositCount*4);
    return [
      {label:'Население',current:Math.floor(planet.population || 0),target:14000,unit:'',met:(planet.population||0)>=14000},
      {label:'Научный центр',current:science,target:3,unit:' ур.',met:science>=3},
      {label:'Суммарные уровни добычи',current:miningLevels,target:miningTarget,unit:'',met:miningLevels>=miningTarget},
      {label:'Оборонные установки',current:defense,target:4,unit:'',met:defense>=4},
      {label:'Удовлетворённость',current:satisfaction,target:80,unit:'%',met:satisfaction>=80}
    ];
  }

  return [];
}

function canAdvanceCivilization(planet,targetLevel){
  const reqs = civilizationRequirements(planet,targetLevel);
  return reqs.length > 0 && reqs.every(r => r.met);
}

function civilizationUnlockText(level){
  const info = civilizationInfo(level);
  return info?.unlocks?.join(' • ') || '';
}

function updateCivilizationProgress(planet){
  if(!planet || planet.owner !== 'player') return false;

  let changed = false;
  let level = getCivilizationLevel(planet);

  while(level < CIVILIZATION_LEVELS.length && canAdvanceCivilization(planet,level+1)){
    level++;
    planet.civilizationLevel = level;
    changed = true;

    const info = civilizationInfo(level);
    pushEvent(
      'УРОВЕНЬ ЦИВИЛИЗАЦИИ: «' + planet.name + '» достигла уровня ' +
      level + ' — «' + info.name + '». Открыто: ' + civilizationUnlockText(level) + '.',
      'success'
    );
  }

  if(changed && currentFleetPlanet === planet){
    renderPlanetMenuTab(planet);
  }

  return changed;
}

function lockedCivilizationHtml(requiredLevel){
  const info = civilizationInfo(requiredLevel);
  return `
    <div class="civilizationLock">
      <span class="civilizationLockIcon">🔒</span>
      <span>Откроется на уровне цивилизации <b>${requiredLevel} — ${info.name}</b></span>
    </div>
  `;
}

function mineTypeForResource(resource){
  return RESOURCE_MINE_TYPES[resource] || null;
}
function mineTypesForPlanet(planet){
  return (planet?.resources || [])
    .map(resource => [resource,mineTypeForResource(resource)])
    .filter(([,type]) => !!type && !!BUILDING_DEFS[type]);
}
function colonyMineStarterStockpile(planet){
  const stock = {};
  for(const [,type] of mineTypesForPlanet(planet)){
    for(const [resource,amount] of Object.entries(BUILDING_DEFS[type]?.cost || {})){
      stock[resource] = (stock[resource] || 0) + amount;
    }
  }
  // Маленький технический резерв поверх точной стоимости всех первых шахт.
  stock['Железо'] = (stock['Железо'] || 0) + 25;
  stock['Медь'] = (stock['Медь'] || 0) + 15;
  stock['Литий'] = (stock['Литий'] || 0) + 10;
  return stock;
}


function sampleUnique(list, count){
  const pool = [...list];
  for(let i = pool.length - 1; i > 0; i--){
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [pool[i], pool[j]] = [pool[j], pool[i]];
  }
  return pool.slice(0, count);
}
function resourceCountForPlanet(radius, isRare){
  const isLarge = radius >= LARGE_PLANET_RADIUS;
  if(isRare) return isLarge ? 3 : 2;
  return isLarge ? 5 : 3;
}
function assignPlanetResources(radius, isRare){
  const source = isRare ? RARE_RESOURCES : COMMON_RESOURCES;
  return sampleUnique(source, resourceCountForPlanet(radius, isRare));
}

function showContextTutorial(icon,title,html){
  if(!gameSettings?.hints) return false;
  const overlay = document.getElementById('contextTutorialOverlay');
  if(!overlay) return false;
  document.getElementById('contextTutorialIcon').textContent = icon || '💡';
  document.getElementById('contextTutorialTitle').textContent = title || 'Подсказка';
  document.getElementById('contextTutorialText').innerHTML = html || '';
  overlay.classList.add('open');
  overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
  return true;
}
